tool_args.rationale: The previous submissions failed due to implementation errors (using y during prediction and an unbound parameter variable), not evidence against the mechanism. This version numerically fits the two-parameter adiabatic relaxation law and stores fitted parameters for prediction, enabling fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Only an extra fine trajectory batch is offered, already acquired; no further probe is available in the listed menu.
Does not account for the explicitly varying initial state x_now and horizon H; the paid observations match an adiabatic relaxation law candidate.
These alternatives depend on u_now and H without the observed x_now initial-state contribution.
